description: This file implements the ActivationWorkingSet class, which manages a set of recently active grain activations within the Orleans runtime. It tracks activation states, promotes activity, evictions, and periodically scans to identify inactive members for removal. It also includes interfaces for working set management and observer notifications.

classes.name: ActivationWorkingSet
classes.description: Manages a set of recently active grain activations, tracks their state, and performs periodic scans to evict idle members based on activity.

methods.name: OnActivated
methods.description: Adds a new activation member to the working set and notifies observers.

methods.name: OnActive
methods.description: Marks an existing member as active and notifies observers.

methods.name: OnEvicted
methods.description: Removes a member from the working set and notifies observers.

methods.name: OnDeactivating
methods.description: Handles a member beginning deactivation, removing it and notifying observers.

methods.name: OnDeactivated
methods.description: Handles a member completing deactivation and notifies observers.

methods.name: MonitorWorkingSet
methods.description: Periodically scans the working set to determine if members should be evicted due to idleness.

methods.name: VisitMember
methods.description: Evaluates a member's eligibility for removal based on its idle state and activity.

methods.name: LogExceptionVisitingWorkingSetMember
methods.description: Logs exceptions encountered during working set member visits.
